steps.say: set up a Job area for my founding-engineer hunt with two parts inside it: a Search module that keeps openings I find, and a Resume module that keeps the versions of my resume I send out
steps.reply:

One catch: Alpha can't rename an existing module, so "Job Search" would stay called that when nested under Job, rather than becoming plain "Search." Two quick questions in the plan:
